applicabilityBasis.summary: BD is minted when users borrow against overcollateralized positions in a decentralized Liquity V2-style protocol and can be redeemed permissionlessly for on-chain collateral. No legal person obligated to convert, redeem, or repurchase BD for a fixed amount of monetary value is identified, leaving its treatment under the GENIUS payment-stablecoin definition unclear.

genius.notes: Base Dollar materials describe protocol-level borrowing and permissionless collateral redemption, but identify no conventional legal issuer or GENIUS pathway. Governance cannot mint BD, although it controls debt limits, collateral additions and revenue parameters. This supports genuine uncertainty about the statutory issuer redemption obligation rather than a categorical DeFi exemption. redemptionPolicyPresent refers to the published protocol collateral-redemption policy, not a fiat redemption promise. Public on-chain collateral visibility and security audits are not treated as issuer reserve disclosures or monthly reserve attestations. No qualifying public approval, state qualification, official application, foreign registration or token-specific enforcement action was located in the dated source search. The primary issuer framework remains proposed; the SCRC procedural IFR does not authorize an issuer. DASP not-yet-restricted records the GENIUS pre-effective posture, not universal legality.
